doc.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997

title: Why he went home to Rome instead of working in a California factory
summary: He repeats that he chose a factory at home near family over one in California.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well after the war years, you worked in the mill during the war years?
Yeah. From California I didn’t want to go to work in a factory there, I says if I’m going to work in a factory I might as well go home and be home with my folks and so forth.
Then who knew how long the war was going to last, or what was going to happen afterwards? So I said I’d rather be home so I did, I came home.
